code-review-graph.repair_hint: pipx install code-review-graph && code-review-graph install && code-review-graph build
code-review-graph.notes: Default code intelligence layer for multi-file reasoning, review, and impact analysis.

superpowers.notes: Method layer for clarification, TDD, debugging, and execution discipline.

repair_hint.claude: claude plugin marketplace add JuliusBrussee/caveman && claude plugin install caveman@caveman

caveman.notes: Communication compression layer; keep separate from planning and code intelligence.

rtk.notes: Compresses Bash/tool output only; built-in Read/Grep/Glob do not pass through RTK hooks.

openspec.notes: Installs the CLI only; project-local 'openspec init' stays explicit.

gsd.notes: Use for phased, cross-session, or parallelized delivery instead of standard one-session work.

repair_hint.opencode: run the ECC installer manually for OpenCode
repair_hint.claude: claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/affaan-m/everything-claude-code && claude plugin install everything-claude-code@everything-claude-code

ecc.notes: Use for framework, security, research, and integration depth; local scope is not supported.

claude-mem.notes: Cross-session memory layer complementary to caveman.
